phase: Phase 4 — Dataset Design and Preprocessing Specification
project: SentinelAI — Industrial Signal Intelligence for Early Machine-Failure Detection
primary_task: Three-class, bearing-disjoint classification of 1-D vibration signals (Healthy, Real Outer-Ring Damage, Real Inner-Ring Damage)

mandated_general_rules.fixed_splits: Strictly mandatory; train on train split only; test split for final number only
mandated_general_rules.baseline_comparison: Mandatory to compare and beat baseline

track1_specific_mandate.scoped_problem: Classify a 1-D or spectrogram signal into its category.
track1_specific_mandate.comment: Unlike Tracks 2-5, Track 1 does not provide a pre-assigned dataset, split, baseline, or metric. These must be rigorously defined and justified by the team.

time_axis_policy.rationale: Hardware acquisition clock is 64 kHz with mean dt = 15.625 microseconds. Timestamp differences in HostService raster reflect host OS software polling jitter. Direct sample indexing avoids interpolating high-frequency signals and prevents interpolation noise.
time_axis_policy.boundary_policy: Deterministic extraction of fixed-length non-overlapping windows starting at index 0. Any samples beyond the windowing budget (including duration outliers in KI16) are truncated.

windowing_overlap_policy.rationale: Strict zero overlap across all partitions. Test and validation windows must represent disjoint physical segments; high overlap inflates sample count and creates correlated evaluation windows. The bearing remains the true independent experimental unit.

normalization_policy.leakage_prevention: Mean and standard deviation are strictly computed across the training split windows. Validation and test sets use training statistics without updating them.
normalization_policy.optional_dc_centering: Subtract per-window mean (x - mean_window) prior to global scaling to eliminate spurious accelerometer electronic DC bias.

recommended_ablation_methods.name: random_phase_shift
recommended_ablation_methods.description: Circular time shift or random start offset within window
recommended_ablation_methods.justification: Phase invariance of continuous rotating machinery

recommended_ablation_methods.name: amplitude_jitter
recommended_ablation_methods.justification: Simulates sensor sensitivity variations and mounting torque changes

recommended_ablation_methods.name: gaussian_noise
recommended_ablation_methods.description: Additive white noise at 25-30 dB SNR (std ~ 0.01)
recommended_ablation_methods.justification: Simulates background plant acoustic and electrical noise

forbidden_augmentations: arbitrary_speed_pitch_scaling (breaks kinematic relationship with known rpm)
cross_class_mixup (creates physically impossible hybrid bearing states)

candidate_bearing_split.defense: Strict bearing-level partitioning prevents data leakage. Validation and test sets achieve exact 1:1:1 class balance. Damage types (fatigue and plastic deformation) are represented in all splits. Outlier bearing KI16 is placed in training to train robustness without compromising evaluation integrity.

operating_conditions_policy.primary_task_treatment: All 4 operating conditions (N15_M07_F10, N09_M07_F10, N15_M01_F10, N15_M07_F04) are equally represented in train, validation, and test (25% of windows each).
operating_conditions_policy.robustness_ablation: Secondary leave-one-condition-out experiment (e.g. train on 3 conditions, evaluate on 900 RPM condition N09_M07_F10) to assess cross-operational domain generalization.
operating_conditions_policy.target_status: Environmental nuisance variable, not a classification target.

current_flaws: Frequency resolution is 250 Hz (64000/256). All bearing fault characteristic frequencies (46-123 Hz) and shaft frequencies (15-25 Hz) collapse into bin 0.
Hop length of 64 generates 1000 time frames per second (1.0 ms temporal step), creating excessive temporal frames and memory overhead while failing to resolve frequency.

recommended_parameters_for_1s.rationale: 31.25 Hz resolution separates BPFO (76.8 Hz) and BPFI (123.2 Hz) at 1500 RPM, and isolates shaft harmonics. 8 ms time step easily captures load zone transits (40 ms shaft period).

recommended_parameters_for_0_5s.rationale: Compact 513x125 2-D representation, fast computation, 62.5 Hz frequency resolution isolates fault fundamental frequencies.

primary_metric_recommendation.rationale: Evaluation partitions (Validation and Test) have balanced 1:1:1 bearing representation. Macro-F1 treats all three diagnostic categories (Healthy, Outer-ring fault, Inner-ring fault) with equal importance, preventing majority-class dominance and providing a clear single leaderboard number.

open_decisions_for_review: Confirm 1.0 s (64,000 samples, 3 windows/file) vs 0.5 s (32,000 samples, 7 windows/file) as the primary input duration.
Formally adopt Macro-F1 as the primary Track 1 benchmark metric.
Approve updating model STFT parameters in configs/config.yaml (e.g. n_fft=2048, hop_length=512 for 1.0s or n_fft=1024, hop_length=256 for 0.5s) to replace the unphysical 256/64 values.
Define the official baseline architecture (e.g. standard 1D-ResNet or 1D-CNN) since the organizer material does not specify a Track 1 baseline.
